units: Probabilities, shares, accuracy and AUC are fractions; fields ending percent_1dp are percentages.

source.commit_status_note: Historical base project commit; see ../EVIDENCE_MAP.md for publication provenance.
source.school_snapshot: Inside Airbnb Melbourne; supplied through subject LMS; collected 17 June–1 July 2026

outcome.label: 30+ guest reviews in the preceding 365 days
outcome.note: The separate reference group defines the cutoff. The analysis sample's 25.3% is observed, not forced by design.

segments.ranking_basis: Observed outcome proportions, not logistic model scores
segments.uncertainty: 90% intervals from the frozen project's host bootstrap; copied and checked, not regenerated by this standalone logistic script.
segments.interpretation: The intervals overlap. These are search candidates, not a certain exact ordering.

model.family: binomial logistic regression, unpenalised R glm
model.scope: Retrospective classification of held-out hosts; no prospective time validation for this model
inputs: Current price relative to training-fold segment median
model.validation: Five folds grouped by host; price medians fitted within training folds; same exploratory sample, not an untouched final external test

full.label: Simple logistic model
full.quota_method: Exactly ceil(n/4) in expectation; fractional weight at tied boundary

baseline_segment_mean.label: Training-fold segment average (fixed smoothing weight 10)
baseline_segment_mean.quota_method: Exactly ceil(n/4) in expectation; fractional weight at tied boundary

baseline_location_type_bedrooms.label: Additive logistic model: council area, property type and bedrooms
baseline_location_type_bedrooms.quota_method: Exactly ceil(n/4) in expectation; fractional weight at tied boundary

repeated_host_splits.note: The 5th–95th percentile range is split sensitivity, not a confidence interval or independent external testing.

scenarios_backup.role: Backup illustration only; comparisons are associations, not intervention effects
scenarios_backup.example: Melbourne 2BR apartment; segment-median price; 43 amenities; one-night stay setting varied

items.scenario: Example listing: Melbourne 2BR apartment, priced like similar listings, accepts 1-night stays, median amenities

temporal_validation.validated_object: Persistence of the earlier top-three segment shortlist, NOT the simple logistic model
temporal_validation.threshold_source: Earlier-window reference-host P75; held fixed for both windows

windows.basis: per-listing last_scraped; both windows rebuilt from raw review dates

temporal_validation.trend_wording: Overall attainment fell; not every segment fell.
temporal_validation.limits: Same surviving listings across two windows. Longer-history sample. No forecast of a new operator's profit. Copied validated project evidence; raw temporal pipeline is not rerun in this compact package.

caveats: Reviews are not bookings, occupancy or profit.
Current settings can differ from settings during the previous year.
Longer stays can generate fewer reviewed stays; test operating changes against actual margin.
Estimated revenue is constructed from reviews and price. It is not used to set rent or cost ceilings.
Listing-level school data and OOF predictions are private working inputs; do not publish them.
